title: Trove reading item
description: One line of reading/<source>/YYYY-MM.jsonl: a saved/read article, bookmark, or RSS item. Additive evolution: readers tolerate unknown fields.

ts.description: RFC3339 local time the item was saved (or read/published, the most identity-bearing time the source exposes)

source.description: collector id; identical to the source folder name (lowercase/digits/dash)

guid.description: source-unique id, the dedupe key (Raindrop/Linkding/Wallabag/Reader item id, Pinboard hash, URL+saved-at hash for exports)

examples: A Deep Dive into Local-First Software

author.description: byline, where the source carries one

feed.description: RSS feed / publication title, for reader sources

excerpt.description: snippet, selection, or the bookmark's own note/description
examples: The cloud is just someone else's computer.

progress.description: read progress as an integer percent, 0–100 (Instapaper, Reader)

read_at.description: RFC3339 local time the item was read / last opened

extra.description: everything source-specific (collection name, cover, shared flag, original CSV position, …)
